answer: Each agent must sign its votes from a sealed chip, and the haven certifies a chip only after recording which buyer's invoice paid for it. Before the k-th chip on one buyer's invoices may carry an agent, that buyer locks 10×k garden with the wharf, which forfeits the lock if the chip is caught serving two agents. An honest newcomer buying one chip locks 10 garden. An operator's 100th clone locks 1,000 garden, and 100 clones lock 50,500, unless it pays unrelated straw buyers to front each purchase.
